headline: Get Jawling
title: How to Get Jawling | The Wind Breaker | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Jawling is a Wind Breaker that bites whatever it finds. Hunt it in Russet Highlands, where wild ones are around levels forty five to fifty, so bring a strong team. It is weak to Lightning and Light. At level thirty eight it evolves into Helmwhelp, which later leads to Helgon or Infergon. Its Counter Strike trait rewards getting hit. Which branch will you pick? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Jawling is a Wind Breaker found in Russet Highlands at levels 45-50. It evolves into Helmwhelp at level 38, which leads to Helgon or Infergon.
